decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD does not align with the firm's curated reissue focus and CD sales are declining.
The illustrated music release series supports the firm's strategy of curated physical editions and has multiple models to attract collectors.
The reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the growing vinyl market and leverages the firm's reissue expertise.
The multi-disc music box set appeals to collectors and can generate high margins despite being a niche product.
The compilation music CD duplicates existing catalog offerings and faces weak demand for generic CD compilations.
